_doc: Facts read from official pages. Overrides list-text requirements in plan.py. Add one entry per verified program with the URL and date read.

AWS Activate.note: Founders (self-funded) tier: start $1K, up to $5K. Needs an AWS account on the Paid Tier plan (card on file) and a Builder ID made 'with your professional email'. Portfolio tier ($200K) needs an Activate Provider Org ID (VC/accelerator).

NVIDIA Inception.note: Free, any funding stage, no fees/deadlines/cohorts. Benefits are training, discounts and partner cloud credits, not a fixed cash credit. Application asks for business and product details.

Oracle for Startups.note: Oracle Cloud Free Tier (not the startup program): $300 for 30 days plus Always Free services, including Arm Ampere A1 compute (24/7 k3s node candidate).
